Subject: Critical-path reshuffle — updated MAP and approvals needed

Hi Samantha / Alex —

Quick note after this morning's sync: the evaluation window pushed out when your infra team requested the longer privacy review (SOC2 artifacts). That shift breaks the current MAP milestones and would move our projected close by ~3 weeks unless we align on acceptance windows and a reduced-scope canary.

I attached MAP_v3.xlsx (summary sheet + milestone owners). Two asks:
- Can procurement confirm whether the SOW redlines can be triaged in parallel with the privacy checklist? If redlines must finish first, we need to factor that into the timeline.
- Can Helios commit to a sign-off window (formal or email) by EOD 2026-08-06 for the reduced-scope canary so we don't slip the final close?

Proposed mitigation (high level):
- Parallelize SOW redline review and the canary evaluation (security will provision scoped logs only).
- Shorten the evaluation set to the 3 highest-priority flows (see MAP_v3 tab "Canary"), run for 72 hours, then decide.
- If canary passes, legal can proceed with the redline cleanup as an administrative step during rollout.

If we can't get the EOD 8/06 sign-off, we should rebaseline the close to 2026-09-01 and lock in a stakeholder call before 8/10 to capture expectations.

Appreciate quick confirmations — I can jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

I've attached SOW_redlines.pdf with our initial comments so legal can see the current ask. If Helios can accept the limited audit scope for the canary, procurement will sign off on parallel review, but we need that documented by tomorrow.

- Alex (on behalf of Acme procurement)

Ben / Alex —

We acknowledge the proposal. Two clarifications from our side:
1) Our security team requires SOC2 artifacts for any production-likely data flows. They are willing to accept a scoped set of logs for the canary but will need the explicit list of fields and retention policy (48 hours max).
2) Our internal legal will only entertain parallel SOW review if the canary is strictly limited and there's an executive-level email approval to proceed.

If Redwood can produce the short eval plan + field-level log spec by EOD 2026-08-04, I will push for an expedited sign-off. Otherwise, we will expect a rebaseline to the first week of September.

Samantha Rojas
